related.title: Nextflow Resume：內容身分與工作目錄完整性
related.titleEn: Nextflow resume: content identity and work-directory integrity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：永久錯誤不無限重試；機率結果標明獨立假設。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Permanent errors are not retried indefinitely; probabilities state independence assumptions.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「Nextflow Resume：內容身分與工作目錄完整性」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付cache身分、輸出manifest、重做集合與task-minutes帳本。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct Nextflow resume: content identity and work-directory integrity with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver cache identities, output manifests, recompute sets and task-minute ledgers.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 畫兩層成功／失敗樹，將兩次都失敗的葉計出。
由240扣180，將60張卡各標5 min，求總工作量。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Draw a two-attempt success/failure tree and calculate the all-failure leaf.
Subtract 180 from 240 and assign five minutes to each of sixty tasks.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Titan XK7：GPU 卸載的損益平衡
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：永久錯誤不無限重試；機率結果標明獨立假設。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Permanent errors are not retried indefinitely; probabilities state independence assumptions.
related.difference: 畫主機與裝置兩條泳道及資料所有權；標出計時開始與完成同步，避免只記enqueue；40/32可重建，等待涵蓋D2H完成，重用版本與CPU參考一致。
related.differenceEn: Draw host/device lanes and data ownership, with timing start and completion synchronization rather than enqueue alone. Reproduce 40/32, wait through D2H and match reused versions to the CPU reference.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 畫兩層成功／失敗樹，將兩次都失敗的葉計出。
不重疊模型T=H2D+kernel+D2H+launch；比較完整路徑，不能只量GPU核函數；合成傳入12、核計算18、傳出8、啟動2毫秒；資料重用後傳入4，其他不變；CPU基準50；名義式 12+18+8+2 = 40 ms；變更式 4+18+8+2 = 32 ms。數據與驗收門檻為原創教學情境，並非所列超級電腦或函式庫的實測規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Draw a two-attempt success/failure tree and calculate the all-failure leaf.

Without overlap, T=H2D+kernel+D2H+launch; compare complete paths rather than kernel-only timings. Synthetic H2D = 12, kernel 18, D2H = 8, launch 2 ms; reuse reduces H2D to 4; CPU baseline 50. Nominal 12+18+8+2 = 40 ms; changed 4+18+8+2 = 32 ms. Inputs and acceptance thresholds are original teaching scenarios, not measured specifications of the named systems or libraries.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
